art_direction: 小帆船位于水面中央，半透明墨帆与三道水平水纹组成简约画面。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Place a small sailboat on still water, viewed from a slightly elevated distance. Its single triangular sail is a translucent ink wash with one darker folded edge; the hull is a short decisive charcoal stroke. Three separated horizontal ripples establish the water without filling the sheet. Position the boat near the central lower area and give its sail room to rise. Add a faint warm-gray horizon that almost disappears into the paper. Exclude people, buildings, sunbursts, and decorative symbols. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
